'''FG36''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[nanovirus]] created by [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], soldiers created from the genome of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="RC:HC" />

[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit [[Omega Squad]] [[Mission to Qiilura|captured]] Uthan on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]] before she completed her virus; it had not yet been narrowed down to one particular genome that the soldiers had, that other beings did not: accelerated aging. After her capture, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] acquired several samples of the virus.<ref name="RC:HC" />

Later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], after the rise of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Uthan's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Gibad/Legends|Gibad]] did not comply with the Empire's demands. Palpatine then ordered the FG36 samples he had kept to be [[Devastation of Gibad|released]] onto the planet, killing every being that was exposed to it. Uthan later created an antigen to it and with the help of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kal Skirata]] and his [[Clan Skirata|boys]] spread it around [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], making the planet immune to the virus.<ref name="IC:501">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
FG36 was first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" /> The nanovirus was later identified in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', which was also written by Traviss.<ref name="IC:501" />
